need: A handoff is a snapshot, so a resuming session can act on a superseded decision if it does not check authoritative decision channels, and a coordinating session needs a safe way to hand off at a turn boundary while workers continue.
evidence: Observed in one adopting project when a coordinator handoff missed a newer owner decision queued around the refresh boundary and acted on the stale option.
limits: Observed in one project. Guidance only; no kit check enforces decision-channel reconciliation, and refresh thresholds, session creation and receipt protocols remain project choices.
sanitization: Removed project names, repository identifiers, counts, specific anecdotes and paths. No credentials, private account data, employer, client or third-party material is included.
